shortDescription: The Shangai Composite Index rose 10 points or 0.25 percent on Tuesday to close at 3943 points.Leading the gains are Avic Aviation Engine (5.82%), Kangmei Pharma (5.07%) and Metallurgical (3.54%).Top losers were Fuyao Glass Indu (-2.60%), Sanan Optoelectron (-1.84%) and Jiangsu Hengrui (-1.36%).
